name: Weekly codebase drift report
description: Each week, summarise what merged and why, flag new helpers that duplicate existing code, measure growth per area and suggest consolidations.

reviewBeforeSaving.note: Choose the repositories to report on. The run reads their default branch history and code, so without one there is nothing to measure.
Runs at 09:00 UTC every Monday and covers the previous 7 days. Change the day or time, or turn the schedule off to run it only on demand.
Starts as Dry run, so a run only writes the report. Raise it to Preview & approve to let the acting step save the suggested consolidations as repository To-Dos.
Needs Claude Code or Codex (or a synthetic pool of them), because the run reads pull request context and searches the repository through ProPR's MCP tools.
